criteria.requirement: Implement Table.increment(column,amount,filters,*,nulls="preserve") with one SQLAlchemy UPDATE expression, never read-modify-write. Require existing numeric SQLAlchemy column, finite int/float/Decimal excluding bool, explicit filters mapping, and nulls=preserve|zero. Zero/negative increments work; unmatched/nonexistent table returns zero, no schema creation. Return reliable database rowcount, preserve existing update/transaction behavior and reject unknown/non-numeric columns or invalid policies before DML. Prove two file-backed SQLite connections accumulate changes and an explicit database transaction rolls back failed work; document backend numeric range/precision limits.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
